# LangChain Expression Language (LCEL)

Prerequisites
Read the runnable interface guide before this conceptual overview.

LCEL composes runnables declaratively so chains get streaming and batching for free.

  Python
Use the pipe operator to compose a prompt, a model and an output parser.

```python
chain = prompt | model | parser  # :::tip stays inside code
```

# How-to guides

Here you will find answers to "How do I...?" types of questions about LangChain.

# How to use chat models to call tools

Prerequisites

This guide assumes familiarity with chat models and tool calling concepts.

sections.heading_path: How to use chat models to call tools > Defining tool schemas
sections.text:
## Defining tool schemas

Pick a chat model that supports tool calling before binding any tools:

```python
def add(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    """Add two integers."""
    return a + b
```

Tool schemas can also be Pydantic models with typed fields and descriptions.
